title: Memory Entry
description: Frontmatter shape for a Field Guide memory entry (docs/memory.md §2, spec §12.1/§12.2/§12.4). One format for a proposal (.agent/memory/proposals/<TASK-ID>-<NN>.md), a standalone discovery/incident file, and a block appended inside a topic file (.agent/memory/<topic>.md). This schema validates only the YAML frontmatter; the markdown body below it (`## <claim>` heading + prose) is not schema-checked. Owner: per-tier approving role (spec §12.2) — Tier A: verifier fleet, Tier B: domain/spec authority, Tier C: design authority. Staleness trigger: `verified` older than `staleness_bound_days` (tier defaults A=60, B=90, C=180), or any `refs[]` entry that no longer resolves — `agent validate` flags both as `status: needs-reverification`, never auto-deletes (spec §12.4).

id.description: Stable entry id, e.g. MEM-AUTH-014. Kept permissive (any uppercase-kebab suffix after 'MEM-') rather than enforcing the illustrative MEM-<AREA>-<NNN> shape literally, since ids are also generated deterministically at proposal time from area + source task (docs/memory.md §2).

tier.description: A = operational fact (verifier approves). B = domain knowledge (domain/spec authority approves). C = architecture (design authority approves). spec §12.2.

areas.description: Kebab-case codebase areas, joined against task payload.areas for recall (docs/memory.md §3 Recall).

owner.description: Owning role (tier default, overridable), e.g. verifier-fleet, domain-authority, design-authority (spec §12.4 'Owner: a role, not a person').

proposed_by.description: Role/agent that proposed the candidate fact (Layer 1, docs/memory.md).

approved_by.description: Approving role, per the tier authority table. Null while status is pending.

verified.description: Last attestation date (YYYY-MM-DD) — set at proposal time and refreshed on every approval/re-verification (spec §12.4).

staleness_bound_days.description: Days after `verified` this entry is treated as needing re-verification. Tier defaults: A=60, B=90, C=180 (docs/memory.md §2), overridable per entry.

refs.description: Code paths (optionally with a '#anchor' suffix) or commits the claim is anchored to. No refs, no trust (docs/memory.md §2) — minItems 1 is load-bearing.

superseded_by.description: Id of the entry that supersedes this one, once expired. Supersession over deletion (spec §12.4, borrowed from Graphiti's temporal model per docs/memory.md §5).

status.description: pending = awaiting tier-gated approval. active = landed, trusted. needs-reverification = `agent validate` flagged stale refs/date; treat as a hint, not truth (spec §12.4). rejected = declined at propose time, reason preserved. expired = retired, superseded_by may point at a replacement.

source_task.description: Task id whose run produced the candidate this entry originated from (Layer 1 -> Layer 2, docs/memory.md).

reason.description: Free-text reason, present on rejected and expired entries (`agent memory reject`/`expire --reason`). Not part of docs/memory.md's illustrative §2 example, which only shows the active-entry shape; added here so reject/expire can preserve their reason in frontmatter per docs/memory.md §3, rather than only in prose.
